{{THERAPIST_NAME}} — a private practice therapist in {{CITY}}, {{STATE}}

I work with people navigating anxiety, trauma, relationship shifts and burnout. Together we create practical, sustainable change — paced to your life.

Licensed: {{LICENSE}} • Modalities: {{MODALITIES}}

{{PRIMARY_CTA_LABEL}} Get in touch

A quiet, practical place to work on what matters

I blend evidence-informed methods with collaboratively set goals. Sessions are straightforward: we identify patterns, try small experiments, and build skills you can use between appointments. I aim to create a relationship that feels steady and respectful — a space where you can bring what's hard and be heard.

I offer telehealth and in-person appointments in {{CITY}}, {{STATE}}. I do not provide emergency services. If you are in crisis, call your local emergency number or a crisis line immediately.

My approach in one map

  1. 1. Clarify

    We name the patterns and choose an initial focus together.

  2. 2. Stabilize

    Practical tools for distress tolerance and daily regulation.

  3. 3. Explore

    Gentle processing of memories, attachment patterns, and beliefs.

  4. 4. Practice

    Behavioral experiments, communication skills, and habit shifts.

Therapy pathways

Choose a pathway that fits your current needs — we can adapt as we go.

Foundations (Short-term)

6–12 sessions focused on symptom relief and skill building for anxiety and burnout.

Repair & Restore

12–24 sessions for processing trauma and strengthening emotion regulation.

Relationships & Communication

Individual or couples work to improve boundaries, communication, and connection.

Investment & plans

Transparent options so you can plan for care.

Drop-in session

$150 / session

Single session, no commitment. Good for consultations or check-ins.

Core package

$135 / session

Block of 10 sessions — consistent momentum, recommended for measurable change.

Extended care

$120 / session

Ongoing weekly work — for deeper processing and long-term goals.

Insurance: I do not bill insurance directly; I provide receipts you can submit to your carrier. Confidentiality is maintained; learn more in the footer.

Stories of change

"I learned how to handle panic without it taking over my life. The work felt practical and respectful of my pace." — Client, 30s
"We worked through patterns that kept repeating in my relationships. I feel more steady and intentional now." — Client, 40s
"Clear tools, reliable structure, and a clinician who listens without judgement." — Client, 20s

Ready to begin?

I'm accepting new clients. Click below to request an appointment or send a question.
